exposure: Urinary incontinence before or during pregnancy
Urinary incontinence in the first year postpartum
Fecal incontinence in the first year postpartum
finding: Women reporting urinary or faecal incontinence during pregnancy had markedly higher odds of reporting symptoms at 4 years postpartum.
mod_finding: Compared with women having only spontaneous vaginal births, women who delivered exclusively by caesarean section were less likely to have urinary incontinence at 4 years postpartum.
